_comment: CVLX CHILD project-air — points the parent's GENERIC project-air mechanism at the LIFEPUNCH tree. The parent knows only 'a name maps to a path under a root'; the names below are the domain. Consumed via CAVELUX_PROJECT_AIR_CONFIG.
_root_note: Absolute by design: this mount is machine-pinned to VENGEANCE (the editor seat). The parent resolves a relative root against its own mcp/ dir, which would be fragile across repos.
